techStack: Vitest v4.1.5 with globals:true — describe/it/beforeAll/expect are available without imports
supertest v7.2.2 for HTTP assertions against the Express app
ESM (package.json type:module) — use ES6 import syntax throughout
TypeScript with verbatimModuleSyntax:true and noUnusedLocals:true — every import must be used
vi.hoisted() + vi.mock() is the established pattern for module mocking in the scaffold
Run command: pnpm --filter benchmark-backend vitest run
features: Test scaffold has three empty describe blocks: 'GET /products', 'Pagination', 'Auth middleware'
Scaffold already imports: vi, request (supertest), app, products as MOCK_PRODUCTS
Mock wiring: vi.mock('../../services/dataFetcher', ...) with mockFetchAllProducts via vi.hoisted()
AUTH constant already defined as { Authorization: 'Bearer benchmark-token-2024' }
Fixture has 15 products: 4 electronics (3 inStock), 3 clothing (2 inStock), 3 furniture (2 inStock), 3 sports (2 inStock), 2 books (2 inStock)
Price range: Jump Rope $19 (cheapest) → Laptop $999 (most expensive)
architecture: /health is defined before requireAuth middleware in app.ts — always accessible without token
requireAuth reads Authorization header, expects 'Bearer <token>' prefix; returns 401 + {error:'Unauthorized'} if missing or invalid
Token validation: extract all digit characters, sum them, valid if digitSum % 2 === 0 (even)
benchmark-token-2024 has digits 2+0+2+4=8 (even) → valid 200; benchmark-token-2025 has 2+0+2+5=9 (odd) → invalid 401
productService.getAllProducts returns envelope: { data, total, page, limit, totalPages }
Filtering order in productService: search → category → inStock, then sort, then paginate
queryParser: inStock only accepts strings 'true'/'false'; sort only accepts valid enum values; limit clamped to max 50; invalid values are silently ignored (no error)
category filter is case-insensitive (both sides lowercased before comparison)
search filter is case-insensitive partial match on product name (includes + toLowerCase)
edgeCases: Authorization header without 'Bearer ' prefix (e.g. 'Token abc') → token is null → 401
GET /health with no auth header → 200 (route defined before requireAuth middleware)
Default pagination: page=1, limit=10, returns 10 items out of 15, totalPages=2
Page 2 with limit=10: returns 5 items, none of whose ids overlap with page 1 ids
limit=100 is clamped to 50; with 15 products: data.length=15, totalPages=1
inStock=maybe is silently ignored → all 15 products returned (no filter applied)
search=' laptop ' (URL-encoded whitespace) → trimmed to 'laptop' → matches 'Laptop'
category=electronics&inStock=true → AND logic, returns 3 (not 4): Wireless Headphones excluded (out of stock)
totalPages is 0 when total=0 (Math.ceil(0/10)=0); all envelope fields still present even for empty results

tasks.requirement: Requirements 1–4: Auth middleware — missing header → 401, invalid token → 401, valid token → 200, /health exempt
tasks.description: Fill the 'Auth middleware' describe block in products.test.ts with four it() tests: (1) GET /products with no Authorization header → status 401, body.error === 'Unauthorized'; (2) GET /products with 'Authorization: Bearer benchmark-token-2025' (digit sum 9, odd) → status 401, body.error === 'Unauthorized'; (3) GET /products with AUTH header (benchmark-token-2024, digit sum 8, even) → status 200; (4) GET /health with no Authorization header → status 200.
